headline: Four filters narrow 30 areas to 5 priorities
subline: How the priorities were chosen · areas left after each step
source: Source: P&I assessment of the 30 areas in the brief.
notes: Criteria, in knock-out order. One: does P&I own the outcome? The savings calculator, reward selection and native entry are squad Klient's; new scoring rules are the council's decision; CRM implementation is the CRM team's. P&I feeds them evidence.
Two: cost of delay. What must exist before Go Big or 30 June? Fénix has a floating deadline, agentic CRM and the self-learning Brain need foundations first.
Three: merge overlaps. Segment definitions and new money vs transfers are part of one metric truth; the dashboard is its output; young clients are one segment.
Four: impact on North Star and CM3, times feasibility with five analysts and our dependency on other teams.
